about: The arena commentator (Dom-approved idea, 2026-10-28; TEXT only, no sound yet): a sarcastic announcer line fades in near the top of the screen on game events. Every line is a row here: event id -> lines, cooldown, probability. src/commentator.ts is the pure picker (deterministic: hash32 of the seed, the event and its own count; never the same line twice running; no Math.random, no clock) and the one-element caption; checkCommentator in src/sim/validate.js is the schema. Caps keep it quiet: a per-event cooldown, a global gap, lines per minute and lines per session; a `priority` event skips the gap and the per-minute cap. Off with localStorage fd3.commentator = 'off' (the game has no menu to hold a toggle row yet). `{name}` in a line is filled from the call's params; a call missing a declared param says nothing. PG-13, no real people, no quoted lines. `wearing_parts` is the extension point for the Frankendom equip feature: call commentator.say('wearing_parts', { partName }) when a taken part is worn.

fight_start.about: a boss engages the hero (params: boss)
lines: {boss} approaches. Please try to look surprised.
Ah, {boss}. Right on schedule, unlike your reflexes.
Round one against {boss}. Odds are grim.
{boss} has entered the chat. Your sword has not.
Here comes {boss}. Remember: pointy end forward.
{boss} looks rested. You look optimistic. Bold.
Fresh meat versus {boss}. Guess which one you are.
{boss} wants a word. The word is 'ouch'.

first_hit.about: the hero's first landed hit of a fight
lines: A hit! Frame it, nobody will believe this.
First blood. Savour it, it is all downhill.
Contact! Even a broken clock, as they say.
Wow, you hit something on purpose.
The crowd gasps. Mostly out of surprise.
One hit down, a few hundred to go.
Look at that, the pointy bit works.

miss_streak.about: several swings in a row hit nothing
lines: Swinging at air again. Very menacing air.
The boss is over there. Slightly to the left.
Four misses. Is the sword on backwards?
You are fighting the wind and the wind is winning.
Cardio is great, but you can hit it too.
That was a lovely breeze you made.
Missing is a strategy. A bad one, but still.
Aim is a setting, you know. It can be turned on.
Your guard just left the building.
Blocked? Not anymore. Shield day is cancelled.
That guard lasted longer than most excuses.
Crunch! That was your defence, wasn't it?
Holding a shield is not the same as using one.
The guard has been dismissed, effective now.
Turtle mode failed. Please try bravery instead.

hero_low.about: the hero's health crosses the low line
lines: You are one sneeze from the floor.
Health is low. Optimism is lower.
Very red, very sad. Maybe run?
Your health bar called. It wants a break.
Bold plan, fighting on fumes.
Almost dead. Make it look intentional.
That is not a health bar, that is a splinter.

boss_low.about: the boss's health crosses the low line
lines: The boss is wobbling. Do not blow it now.
Nearly there. Try not to celebrate early.
He is hurting. Be a little cruel about it.
A sliver of health left. Finish him, hero.
Even the boss thinks you might win. Weird.
Almost dead. For him, I mean. This time.
The beast is bleeding. Go on, be rude.
{boss} is down. The floor thanks you for the company.
Victory! Somebody tell the family.
And {boss} falls. Even I did not see that coming.
A win. Do not let it go to your head.
{boss} is dead. Pity, they were so punctual.
Flawless. By a very generous definition.
Dead boss, happy crowd. Do it again.
One fewer problem and one more story.

star_1.about: the fight starts against a 1-star boss (params: boss)
lines: A one-star {boss}. How considerate.
One star on {boss}. Somebody upgraded the menu.
{boss}, now with a star. Free of charge.
A shiny {boss}. Shinier means angrier.
That {boss} has a star. Not a participation one.
One star. The kind that comes with teeth.
{boss} with a star on. Fancy.

star_2.about: the fight starts against a 2-star boss (params: boss)
lines: A two-star {boss}, how generous.
Two stars on {boss}. Someone loves you.
{boss}, two stars. Hope you wrote a will.
Double-starred {boss}. Doubly unfair, doubly fun.
Two stars! The house is feeling cruel today.
A two-star {boss}. Ambition has a price.
{boss} in gold. Try not to dent the trophy.

cut.about: a part is cut off a corpse (params: part)
lines: And that, folks, is a {part}. It was attached earlier.
Snip! Somebody needed that {part}.
Bits are now loose. Collect them for later.
Dismembered. Sorry, no refunds.
That {part} belonged to someone a moment ago.
A fine cut. The anatomy teacher is proud.
Off it comes. Tidy work, butcher.
Spare parts! Always handy.
And down goes our hero. Again.
You died. Hardly a shock.
Lie there. The floor is comfortable, we hear.
Another defeat, another lesson ignored.
Embarrassing. Do it quieter next time.
Rest in pieces. Try the guard button.
That was fast. Even the boss looks sorry.
Deceased. Please collect your dignity at the door.
Back already? Optimism is a renewable resource.
Welcome back. The boss kept your seat warm.
Round two. Try something different.
Up you get. Nobody saw. Everybody saw.
A fresh start, same old you.
Resurrected! The refund policy still applies.
On your feet, champion. Allegedly.

retrieve.about: the hero gets his pile back
lines: You found your stuff. It was right where you died.
Corpse run complete. Dignity not included.
Got it back. Maybe do not drop it twice.
Retrieved! The pile is relieved, too.
Pockets full again. Try keeping them that way.
Reclaimed. The ground is a rubbish bank.
Gear back, pride still missing.

roll_spam.about: several rolls in a few seconds
lines: Roll, roll, roll. Fighting or doing laundry?
You are not a barrel. Though you roll like one.
Rolling away from your problems works until it does not.
That is a lot of tumbling for one hero.
A dodge is a plan. Forty dodges is a hobby.
Dizzy yet? The boss is, just watching.
Somersault enthusiast detected.

idle.about: the hero stands still with nobody fighting him
lines: Standing still is a bold opening move.
Asleep? The boss is polite, but not that polite.
The arena is waiting. So are we.
Nothing is happening and you are leading it.
Are you stretching or just scared?
Take your time. We have eternity.
Any day now. Really, no hurry.

wearing_parts.about: EXTENSION POINT, not hooked yet: the Frankendom equip feature calls commentator.say('wearing_parts', { partName }) when a taken part is worn (params: partName)
lines: Nice {partName}. It looks borrowed.
Wearing a {partName} now? Fashion has fallen.
That {partName} does not match your shoes.
A {partName} on you. The previous owner objects.
Fresh {partName}, still slightly warm.
Bold choice, the {partName}. Very you.
The {partName} suits you. Sadly.

limb_loss.about: a boss's armour fails and a limb comes off mid-fight (src/fight/mechanics, data/mechanics.json reginald-limb-loss; params: limb); always said, it is the tell
lines: Sir Reginald's {limb} just left the group chat.
There goes the {limb}. He did not use it much.
The {limb} is gone. Armour was a suggestion.
That {limb} was on a short lease.
Down a {limb}. The knight is rethinking his plan.
The {limb} fell off. Nobody told the knight.
